_meta.purpose: Curated, structured catalog of Djezzy roaming forfaits, per destination. Source of truth for the ROAMING route, replacing brittle parsing of the scraped roaming pages (which mix 'Internet & Voix' and 'Internet seul' families and use inconsistent 'Pour X DA' vs 'X DA' price layouts).
_meta.source: Extracted from data/djezzy_pages.json and verified against the PUBLIC djezzy.dz site (2026-06-28). Égypte, Tunisie, France, Espagne, Hadj/Omra price-verified by the user; Turquie from the scrape (verify).
_meta.verify_note: Djezzy roaming exists ONLY for these destinations. Maroc, Dubai, Émirats are NOT offered (they were phantom router triggers, removed). CAN (Coupe d'Afrique des Nations 2025, Maroc) was a seasonal event offer, now removed from the site.
